title: Friday Night Magic 2002: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: "Fire is the test of gold; adversity, of strong men." —Seneca, "On Providence," trans. Basore
"The chill, to him who breathed it, drew / Down with his blood, till all his heart was cold." —Alfred, Lord Tennyson, *Idyls of the King*
"Everything in Nature contains all the powers of Nature." —Ralph Waldo Emerson, "Compensation"
"One pain is lessened by another's anguish." —William Shakespeare, *Romeo and Juliet*
"As if his chest had been a mortar, he burst his hot heart's shell upon it." —Herman Melville, *Moby Dick*
"When good men die their goodness does not perish, / But lives though they are gone." —Euripides, *Termenidae*, trans. Morgan
